//overrides.react-router: GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2. ra-core declares peer ^6.28.1 || ^7.1.1 and the fix exists only in 8.3.0, so this pin is deliberately outside what react-admin asks for. The advisory itself scopes the flaw to unstable RSC APIs react-admin does not use, so the pin buys a clean audit rather than a closed hole -- which is why it was only kept after the panel was driven in a browser, not merely typechecked. Drop it the moment react-admin's peer range reaches 8.

//overrides.decode-uri-component: GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr (exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input, fixed in 0.5.0), via ra-data-simple-rest and ra-core > query-string. This one SHIPS in the bundle and the panel decodes its own URL query with it. The fix is ESM-only with a default export while query-string 7 loads it with require(), so the pin alone makes every parse throw; the shared patch ../../../admin/patches/query-string@7.1.3.patch makes that one require() accept the module namespace. query-string 8+ is no alternative because it drops the named parse/stringify exports ra-core imports. The pin sits outside query-string's declared ^0.2.2; drop it and the patch when ra-core moves off query-string 7.
